title: Audit outdated dependencies
description: Review the current Bun, Pi, TypeBox, and TypeScript dependency versions, update compatible packages through Bun, and run the full check before keeping any changes.

logs.msg: Updated Pi dev/runtime development dependencies to 0.83.0, TypeBox to 1.3.10, and TypeScript to 7.0.2 via bun; added pi-ai 0.83.0 as a direct dev dependency because src imports it. bun run check passes (168 tests, 402 assertions, typecheck clean); bun outdated reports no remaining package updates.
